note: Ratchet, not a target. The structural rules (file_length, type_body_length, function_body_length, cyclomatic_complexity) and the 120-character line_length preference are accepted debt, and since #0106 the layout itself is owned by swift-format, enforced by scripts/check-format.sh and CI. function_body_length is recorded at 26 rather than 21 because the formatter wraps long calls across lines: the same bodies measure longer without any logic being added. Lower this budget when violations are removed; never raise it silently.
